stem: During the colonial period, what was one difference between slave labor in the North and slave labor in the South?

options.label: A
options.text: More slaves in the North worked in gold mines.

options.label: B
options.text: More slaves in the North worked in cash-crop production.

options.label: C
options.text: More slaves in the North worked in trade-related jobs.

options.label: D
options.text: More slaves in the North worked as craftsmen on plantations.
